title: Australian Bakery Listed on Good Food App
summary: Little Sister Bakery, located in Sandringham, has been listed on The Age Good Food app. The Sydney Morning Herald and The Age both reported on this listing. No further details regarding the bakery's offerings or the app's content were provided in the coverage.
summary_points: Little Sister Bakery is located in Sandringham.

The Age also reported the listing.
